summary: A long, busy shopping-mall basement reached by an escalator down from the street plaza and through automatic glass doors. One main tiled corridor, about 180 metres of walking, runs past shops, two sets of escalators to the upper floor, a café and a children's playground. It turns right at a wide hall with a big pillar and later bears left at the Orange phone shop. At the far end, a second set of automatic doors leads into a food court, where Honest Greens is on the left and Hamburguesa Nostra is on the right.

metal comb plate where the escalator starts

nodes.name: Playground

nodes.name: Food court doors

nodes.name: Honest Greens

notes: The map comes from a single walk (20261010T180004Z_4d83), so every edge has been walked only once, in one direction. Reverse instructions are mirrored, not recorded.

Floor levels are assumed: the plaza at the top of the entrance escalator is labelled '0' and everything after the escalator '-1'. It is not known whether the entrance escalator also runs up; check before using the reverse of e1.
The 'stairs' tags at c12 and c45 are escalators up to the upper floor that the walker passed but did not take. They are mapped as stair nodes beside the route. Their upper ends were not recorded.
'there is a playground to the net' was read as 'to the left', which matches c34.
The walker said 'turn left' at the Orange shop, but the motion data gives about 57° (c38 turn_deg). So e10 uses bear_left by the rule.
Uncertain turns: e5 (c16) uses straight even though turns zigzag at c17 to c19; c16 looked left at the café tables. e6 follows c21's +37° turn_at as bear_right.
After arriving, the walker stepped across the aisle to Hamburguesa Nostra (c56 to c58) and turned back about 68° left to Honest Greens (c59, c60). That return is the same edge e15 walked back.
Left out: c18 (blurred close-up of a sign). Several corridor frames are cited only as edge evidence: c04, c10, c13, c17, c26, c29 to c31, c38, c39, c46, c49, c50, c53, c56.
Odometry is approximate. The long 24 m stretch before the playground has no frames in between.
Record next: walks in the opposite direction, the upper ends of the escalators, other entrances, and the food court beyond Honest Greens.
